name: What is included in a roof replacement warranty?

mainEntity.name: What is included in a roof replacement warranty?

acceptedAnswer.text: A comprehensive roof replacement warranty typically includes two main components: a material warranty from the manufacturer and a workmanship warranty from the installer. The material warranty covers defects in the roofing materials themselves, such as premature cracking or delamination, for a specified period, often 20-50 years depending on the product. The workmanship warranty covers issues related to the installation quality, like leaks caused by improper flashing or inadequate fastening, usually for 5-10 years. Always review warranty details carefully to understand coverage and exclusions.
acceptedAnswer.description: A roof replacement warranty includes a material warranty from the manufacturer and a workmanship warranty from the installer, covering defects and installation issues.
